items.title: Options Say Marvell Stock Could Halve Or Nearly Double In A Year
items.summary: Marvell Technology (MRVL) shares trade near $261, and its options price a one-year range of about $133 to about $514. In plain terms, a rough but ordinary year from here could leave the stock at roughly half today's price or nearly double it. Yet that range is still calmer than the ride holders had over the past twelve months.

items.title: Trump Stance on AI an 'Extremely Naive Position,' Says Sen. Michael Bennet
items.summary: Democrat Senator from Colorado Michael Bennet said that the American people want a president more focused on high interest rates and fuel prices rather 'than throwing reporters out of the White House and the glamour of his dinner with the president of China.' Bennet also weighed in on talks around AI safety and said that the Presidents decision to not enact guardrails is an 'extremely naive position.'

items.title: NVIDIA Stock Looks Expensive Until You Price The Vera Rubin Ramp
items.summary: NVIDIA (NVDA) stock trades near $225, about 28.3 times its adjusted earnings over the past twelve months. Adjusted here means normalized net income with stock-based compensation added back, the same broad basis analysts use in their forecasts. For a stock near its 52-week high, that looks steep. But the multiple leaves out the growth analysts already expect, and that growth depends on how much NVIDIA can supply.
